stem: ![](asset:P000517-stem-1) A 10 kg block is pulled along a frictionless cylindrical surface of radius R = 10m. The applied force F is constant at 200N through a string passing over a smooth pulley Q of negligible size. P is the lowest point of the surface and OQ makes 60° with the vertical OP. If the block was initially at P, then what will be its kinetic energy when it reaches Q?

assets.alt: A mass m pulled along a circular arc of radius R by a horizontal force F, from P, directly below the centre, to Q, at 60° from the vertical.
